sources.title: Independent information-relative rule and paired-metric derivation
sources.details: See a5. Worlds H=3 and H=4 share observable O when count is unavailable, so O does not entail answer3. An observed count3 or explicit trusted red=>3 rule restricts admissible worlds to H=3. Adding a red field without that rule leaves both worlds possible. A hidden target3 would add -log p(3|missing O) to supervision. Row branches give str(3) and the missing-info literal, with print space/LF defaults. Transparent paired-metric counterexample has known counts0,3 and two missing inputs: always3 earns known1/2,missing0/2; alwaysclarify earns known0/2,missing2/2. These are hand derivations, not measured model data.
